# <span style="color:var(--md-accent-fg-color)">**Trust\-region Methods for a Strongly Nonlinear Truss**</span>

A coarse load increment drives the yielding corotational truss through a difficult equilibrium region. The short example isolates the trust\-region update from the underlying finite\-element model.

This example compares the standard Newton algorithm with two TrustRegion subproblem methods. The three\-bar truss uses a corotational formulation and a yielding steel material, so both geometric and material nonlinearities are present.

Only four large load steps are used. Newton cannot pass the third step, while the trust\-region methods complete the same loading path.

```matlab

clear; clc; close all;

toolbox = OpenSeesMatlab();
ops = toolbox.opensees;

solverNames = ["Newton", "TrustRegion Newton", "TrustRegion Dogleg"];
solverTypes = ["newton", "trust-newton", "trust-dogleg"];
numSteps = 10;
loadStep = 0.5;
referenceLoad = 160.0;

displacement = nan(numSteps + 1, numel(solverNames));
force = nan(numSteps + 1, numel(solverNames));
completedSteps = zeros(numel(solverNames), 1);
returnCode = zeros(numel(solverNames), 1);
displacement(1, :) = 0.0;
force(1, :) = 0.0;

```

## Run the same truss with each algorithm
```matlab
for i = 1:numel(solverNames)
    ops.wipe();
    ops.model("basic", "-ndm", 2, "-ndf", 2);

    % Geometry in inches
    ops.node(1,   0.0,   0.0);
    ops.node(2,  72.0,   0.0);
    ops.node(3, 168.0,   0.0);
    ops.node(4,  48.0, 144.0);
    ops.fix(1, 1, 1);
    ops.fix(2, 1, 1);
    ops.fix(3, 1, 1);

    % Steel02: yield stress = 36 ksi, E = 29000 ksi
    ops.uniaxialMaterial("Steel02", 1, 36.0, 29000.0, 0.02, ...
        18.0, 0.925, 0.15);
    ops.element("CorotTruss", 1, 1, 4, 4.0, 1);
    ops.element("CorotTruss", 2, 2, 4, 4.0, 1);
    ops.element("CorotTruss", 3, 3, 4, 4.0, 1);

    ops.timeSeries("Linear", 1);
    ops.pattern("Plain", 1, 1);
    ops.load(4, referenceLoad, 0.0);

    ops.constraints("Plain");
    ops.numberer("Plain");
    ops.system("BandGeneral");
    ops.test("NormUnbalance", 1.0e-8, 40, 0);

    switch solverTypes(i)
        case "newton"
            ops.algorithm("Newton");
        case "trust-newton"
            ops.algorithm("TrustRegion", "-subproblem", "newton", ...
                "-initialRadius", 0.25, "-maxRadius", 10.0);
        case "trust-dogleg"
            ops.algorithm("TrustRegion", "-subproblem", "dogleg", ...
                "-initialRadius", 0.25, "-maxRadius", 10.0);
    end

    ops.integrator("LoadControl", loadStep);
    ops.analysis("Static");

    fprintf('\n%s\n', solverNames(i));
    for step = 1:numSteps
        returnCode(i) = ops.analyze(1);
        if returnCode(i) ~= 0
            fprintf('Stopped at step %d.\n', step);
            break;
        end

        completedSteps(i) = step;
        displacement(step + 1, i) = ops.nodeDisp(4, 1);
        force(step + 1, i) = ops.getLoadFactor(1) * referenceLoad;
    end
end
```

## Results
```matlab
summary = table(solverNames.', completedSteps == numSteps, completedSteps, ...
    returnCode, 'VariableNames', ...
    {'Algorithm', 'Completed', 'Steps', 'ReturnCode'});
summary
```

| |Algorithm|Completed|Steps|ReturnCode|
|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--:|
|1|"Newton"|false|2|-3|
|2|"TrustRegion Newton"|true|10|0|
|3|"TrustRegion Dogleg"|true|10|0|

```matlab

figure('Color', 'w');
hold on; grid on; box on;
for i = 1:numel(solverNames)
    plot(displacement(:, i), force(:, i), '-o', 'LineWidth', 1.5, ...
        'DisplayName', solverNames(i));
end
xlabel('Horizontal displacement of node 4 (in)');
ylabel('Horizontal load (kip)');
title('Strongly nonlinear truss');
legend('Location', 'northwest');
set(gca, 'FontName', 'Arial', 'FontSize', 12);
```

## Reading the result

The Newton curve stops at the last converged load level. Both trust\-region variants reach the target load; the shared converged points confirm that step control changes the solution process, not the equilibrium path.
